repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

## Maintainer ruling · where public forms are designed · 2026-11-24T01:11Z

Raised by seat 3 from #36505 (the Studio object page's 「表单」 tab becomes 「字段布局」, field groups only) against objectstack#1's open PR #36784 (#36444), which puts a 「Record form | Public forms」 switch inside that tab. Asked in the os-support-ai fleet project after an independent contract-tier review. The maintainer (Yibo Wang), verbatim, 2026-11-24T01:07Z: 「对外表单不应该和对象放在一起吧，是不是应该一个单独的元数据列表？」; then on the seat's decision card at 2026-11-24T01:08Z, option picked: 「Studio 单独一页，存储不变」 (the other option, a new metadata type with a migration, was not taken).

## Ruling

1. Public forms are designed on their own Studio page: the existing Developer → Public Forms list (`nav_public_forms` in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts`), upgraded into the designer per #36444 ruling 7100386248 items 1–5. Each form picks the object it writes to; the designer does NOT live in the object page's tabs.
2. Storage is unchanged: a public form stays a `formViews.<name>` entry with `sharing` in the object's view metadata (7100386248 "Definition (unchanged shape)"; no new metadata type).
3. This settles 7100386248 item 1's "placed under the object it belongs to" as "bound to its object", not "inside the object page".
4. The object page's renamed 「字段布局」 tab edits field groups only and carries no public-forms switch (#36505 item 4 as filed).
5. Settings 「对外表单」 (operations, items 6–10 of 7100386248) is unchanged.

Precedent read for the maintainer: ServiceNow Record Producers and Power Pages forms are separate assets bound to one table; internal record layouts stay with the table.
